profile.headline: Software Engineer at The MathWorks
profile.summary:
I have over 5 years of experience as a software developer working from start to end in various distributed n-tier enterprise applications. Recently, I graduated from San Jose State University with masters in Software Engineering where I have been honing my skills with the latest trends in distributed systems as well as diving into the buzz of big data and cloud technologies.

Previously, I worked for Bank of America  as a software developer where I was making life easier for the customers by developing applications and systems for the bank associates.

I recently joined The MathWorks as a software engineer where I work on building tools and applications to help automate the build, test and deploy processes for MATLAB.

Competencies : distributed applications, cloud computing, Java

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked as an intern in research team, co-filed a patent proposal for storage and retrieval optimization technique for multiple resolution versions of the image.

Worked on a POC project, created micro-service architecture using Spring Cloud Netflix and Apache Accumulo as a back-end data store for image storage/retrieval.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked in an early stage start up developing an online food/grocery order and delivery system. 

Front end: JSP, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery
Back end: Spring MVC, Hibernate, REST, MySql

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Developed, improved and managed large scale enterprise applications like credit card booking, populate and print bank forms, KYC application, subscribe/unsubscribe electronic alerts, etc.

My responsibilities include:
- Requirement understanding and gathering with the help of business partners
- Detailed design of application
- Prepare estimates for future releases
- Software development and perform self/peer/group review
- Unit, component, system testing and resolve performance testing issues
- Onsite coordination 
- Mentoring team and conducting knowledge transfer sessions

honors.title: Juniper Networks Innovation Contest
honors.description: Awarded for developing an Apache Spark powered data analytics plugin to process streaming data generated by network devices. The solution also provides real time analysis of network device data with continually-updated visualizations of network statistics.

projects.title: Cloud backup drive using Raspberry Pi
projects.description:
This is a utility application, run on raspberry pi, to backup the flash drive data to the cloud storage . A standalone jar application is deployed on the pi which continuously checks for flash drive, once found it checks for the drop box data, compare them and upload the most recent data to dropbox.

Technologies used: Raspbian OS on Raspberry Pi, JAVA, Spring Boot, Dropbox as cloud storage ,REST APIs for Dropbox,

projects.title: A Cloud Provisioning Self Healing System using VMware vSphere
projects.description:
This is a system that provides on-demand cloud resources with automated disaster recovery facility and analytics for managing and monitoring virtual environment. System is divided in to four parts.
• Cloud provisioning through Spring MVC UI
• Disaster Recovery System through VMware JAVA API (vijava)
• Monitoring services through Logstash
• Log analytics through Kibana
